name: NOAA ENC Morro Bay harbor and nearshore chart depth context

temporal.update_cadence: Service refreshed weekly; chart and original survey dates vary

evidence.supports: Official NOAA chart feature download service
ENC Direct soundings are in metres
NOAA public chart products have no use restrictions; not a grant for privately acquired raw surveys

limitations: Chart products are generalized; display mesh spacing is not native survey resolution.
Local vertical datum metadata absent; no transformation applied.
Quality attributes include historical surveys; collection date is not survey date.
Only bounded water-clipped interpolation and depth-band midpoint estimates; do not infer rocks, habitat, catch probability or navigation clearance.

transformations: Complete bounded query pagination with raw extract hashes
Wet-area constrained inverse-distance interpolation, 750 m maximum reach
Range-only midpoint when no valid nearby sounding
Full triangle water clipping; native survey samples excluded
